verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Runpod serves an llms.txt at docs.runpod.io (HTTP 200, titled 'Runpod Documentation'), and its docs pages are published at .md URLs. The docs also include agent-oriented material, such as the Agent Skills guide for driving Runpod in natural language and the MCP servers page aimed at coding agents. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt index's depth or an llms-full.txt variant, and independent user reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.runpod.io/llms.txt # Runpod Documentation
Once installed, you can ask your agent to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy your own code with Flash, all in natural language.
Runpod provides two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod
